paragraphs.text: Nailah's Keep , originally the Castle of El-Hajjâj , was the residence of the Sorceress Queen Nailah in the Crags of Sana'a on Rabiah the Infinite . It was previously the citadel of her father, a powerful wizard of the Rabian Planes .

When the Dervish Taysir and Raghib arrived after dueling the Sorceress Queen Nailah in Bassorah , the castle of El-Hajjâj was submerged by an illusionary lake that the Dervish Taysir dispelled. He and Raghib entered, fought Brass Men and a Guardian Beast , and found El-Hajjâj himself in his workshop with a City in a Bottle .
The Apprentice Taysir was imprisoned in an oubliette in Nailah's sanctuary inside the Keep.
